claims.statement: Management expects the general merchandise and apparel business contribution to remain in the 22% to 23% range.
claims.quote: we expect this particular part of the business to be somewhere in that 22% to 23% kind of a range.

claims.statement: Management targets approximately 15% store additions on the existing base.
claims.quote: the number that is driving us is that 15% ballpark number on what we want to achieve as store additions on our base.

claims.statement: Management states that same-store growth for older stores will likely hover around current levels and not increase considerably.
claims.quote: same-store growth would possibly be hovering more in the range that we are seeing today, and we are not likely to see that go up considerably

claims.statement: Management expects quick commerce impact on older stores to remain over the next few years.
claims.quote: I'm suspecting that that's not going to change over the next few years. And so therefore, that impact would remain

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts has 68 leased stores out of a total base of 500.
Avenue Supermarts added 85 stores last year, of which 15 were on a lease model.
facts.quote: we had 15 stores added last year, which were on the lease model out of the 85.

facts.statement: Healthy gross margin for DMart is in the range of 14% to 15%.
facts.quote: our healthy gross margin is in the range of 14% to 15%
